claim: Public certificates issued through ACM are valid for 198 days, except ACME-issued certificates, which are valid for 45 days; private certificates issued directly from a private CA without ACM certificate management can use any validity period.

values.display: you can choose any validity period

evidence.quote: Public Certificates issued through ACM are valid for 198 days. If you issue private certificates directly from a private CA and manage the keys and certificates without using ACM for certificate management, you can choose any validity period, including an absolute end date or a relative time that is days, months, or years from the present time.
evidence.title: AWS Certificate Manager FAQs | Certificate Management | Amazon Web Services

evidence.quote: The validity period for ACME-issued certificates is 45 days, which is shorter than the validity period for other ACM public certificates.
